methodPicker.label: Connection method
methodPicker.help: When both methods are available for a service, choose which one users connect through. Leaving this blank lets users pick at connect time.
methodPicker.infoNative: Direct OAuth with this service. Tighter scopes, simpler permissions, surfaced through Numa's connectors and Files Remote.
methodPicker.infoPipedream: Pipedream-managed OAuth with a broad pre-built action library. Best when you want lots of ready-made actions without building them yourself.
methodPicker.infoLetUserChoose: Each user picks their preferred method when connecting. Use this when both options are valid and you want the user's circumstances to decide.

addModal.title: Add integration
addModal.intro: Pick a service to add. Services with multiple connection options will ask you which to use next.

addModal.nativeSetup: Setup required: you'll register an OAuth app with this service and paste the client ID + secret. Takes a few minutes.
addModal.pipedreamBody: Pipedream-managed OAuth. Numa's shared OAuth app, broad pre-built action library users can call from chat.
addModal.pipedreamSetup: No setup required — enables immediately on this workspace.
addModal.userChoiceBody: Enable both methods. Users see both options at connect time and pick the one that fits them — no default forced.
addModal.userChoiceSetup: Enables Pipedream immediately, then opens the native setup wizard so both methods are available.
